items.title: How to Send an Image to an LLM via API (Vision Guide) — OpenRouter Blog
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「大模型训练、推理、RAG、后训练或评测」。原文摘要显示：Send images to any vision-capable LLM with one request shape: a content array with a text part and an image_url part. Covers base64 vs hosted URLs, model selection, multiple images, tokenization, and multimodal RAG.
items.insightText: 关注数据、训练、推理、RAG 或评测设计，评估是否能沉淀到轨迹/地址大模型架构。
